case_study_packaging.headline: Regional food distributor unlocks $1.1 million in annual savings in under nine months with Treya’s strategic sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Royal Food Service was contending with rising logistics, packaging, and labor costs while operating a largely decentralized purchasing model. Leadership needed to quickly capture hard-dollar savings across indirect spend to protect margins, but limited line-item data and tight year-end timelines made in-house execution challenging. They turned to Treya Partners to deliver meaningful cost reductions without disrupting service quality to restaurants, schools, and hospitals throughout the Southeast.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A regional fresh-produce distributor was contending with rising logistics, packaging, and labor costs while operating a largely decentralized purchasing model. Leadership needed to quickly capture hard-dollar savings across indirect spend to protect margins, but limited line-item data and tight year-end timelines made in-house execution challenging. They turned to Treya Partners to deliver meaningful cost reductions without disrupting service quality to restaurants, schools, and hospitals throughout the Southeast.
approach_summary: Analyzed $33.9 million in indirect spend across 15 categories, prioritizing the top five areas that represented 76 % of baseline costs.
Executed competitive multi-round RFPs and direct negotiations for inbound freight and key packaging streams, securing best-in-market pricing while retaining trusted incumbents.
Consolidated staffing agencies and reduced mark-ups, saving 4 % on a $4.9 million contingent labor baseline with zero shift interruptions.
Shifted the client to the Grainger OMNIA GPO program and implemented market-indexed DEF fuel pricing to capture quick-hit wins outside the primary focus areas.
Installed a unified supplier communication playbook and savings-tracking dashboard that enabled 96 % of identified savings to be implemented within the project window.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $1,098,629 in verified annual run-rate savings, landing squarely within the client’s $0.9–$1.7 million target range and with 96 % already flowing through the P&L. Quick-win changes generated measurable benefits within the first 180 days, and the engagement also strengthened supplier panels, extended payment terms, and provided the client with ongoing visibility through a new savings dashboard and governance cadence.
where_we_were_unique: Achieved 96 % savings implementation in less than nine months, accelerating time-to-value.
Balanced cost reduction with operational continuity by negotiating lower rates with preferred incumbents rather than forcing wholesale supplier changes.
Converted incomplete internal data into actionable baselines by partnering directly with suppliers for usage detail.
Delivered cross-category expertise—freight, packaging, labor, fuel, and MRO—within a single, integrated sourcing program.
